samples.evidence: Adolescents (32: ... 56% male) ... were randomized to SPARX ... (n = 20) or to waitlist control (n = 20). These processes resulted in uneven group sizes (20:12). The mean age of participants was 14.9 years (range 13–16, SD = .79), 18 (56%) were male, 11 (34%) were Maori, 12 (38%) were Pacific island, 8 (25%) were New Zealand European and 1 was of other ethnicity. Remission rates using ITT analyses were 15/20 (75%) of the SPARX group compared to 5/12 (41.7%) of those in the wait group.
